living: Start the day or wind down in a bright living room with a large L-shaped sofa, TV and big windows facing the greenery – enough seating for the whole group.
kitchen: Cook together in a fully equipped kitchen with fridge, dishwasher, oven, stove, microwave, coffee machine, kettle and rice cooker, then sit down at one table for shared meals.
bed1: A calm retreat with a double bed, air conditioning and its own vanity corner.
bed2: Double bed, air conditioning and a TV – comfortable for a quiet evening in your own room.
bed3: Double bed, air conditioning and a TV, with fresh towels and bed linen provided.
bath: Bathrooms with rain showers, towels and hair dryers mean no queueing in the morning, even with a full house. Handrails are installed.
ent: A separate room for evenings together – a house with karaoke: sing, watch a film on the projector screen or play on the PlayStation.
hall: Self check-in via keypad leads you into the entrance; stairs with handrails connect the floors.
roof: Terrace with a lounge, outdoor dining area and BBQ grill, plus views across the river and the skyline – a house with river view from the top floor and three balconies.
